indicator_name: Chicago Fed National Financial Conditions Index (NFCI), monthly average
description: Индекс финансовых условий ФРБ Чикаго (NFCI), среднее за месяц
methodology: Index (0 = average, positive = tighter than average), Chicago Fed National Financial Conditions Index, weekly, monthly average of the weeks ending in the month. The Chicago Fed revises the whole history every week. FRED series NFCI.
